title: Multistage scan dimension and finite gauge completeness
accepted_new_scope: For T_N=3I+L_N+L_N^T+E_00, the exact rational parity Schur complement is (7I+4E_00-L_n-L_n^T)/3; only modulo five is it 3T_n. The distinct J_N=-2I+L_N+L_N^T+E_00 has Schur complement J_n/2.
For the full, not necessarily symmetric pentadiagonal tangent at T_(2n), dS is onto B_2(n) and has kernel dimension 5n (relevant n>=4, characteristic not three). This is a local stage statement.
The actual bit-reversal dressed odd-sector pivot is G=O/9, with O=(T_N P_N T_N)[odd,odd]. For N=4h, h=2^q, q>=1, rank_Q G=rank_Q O=h+q+1=N/4+log2(N)-1.
Over F5, pivot rank is h+q+1 for even q and h+q for odd q. These field-specific ranks are distinct. The pivot is singular for every dyadic N>=16 over both fields.
The integer vectors (3e_x,-P_h D^T P_h e_x), x outside {2^b-1:0<=b<=q}, form the rational pivot-nullspace basis. They remain independent over F5, where odd q adds one null dimension.
This refutes only the stagewise odd-sector elimination route requiring that specified pivot to be invertible.
